purpose: Fast source routing before full-text GitHub code search; routing hints are not in-game verification

version_guard.warning: Confirm the installed mod and pack version before using these source-derived recipes

routing.applies_when: item ID starts with gtceu: and its name has a voltage prefix (e.g. lv_assembler)
routing.match_strategy: identify generic machine type (assembler) from registry ID, locate GTMachines.ASSEMBLER rather than searching for generated lv_assembler literal
routing.output_registrar: registerMachineRecipe creates a crafting recipe for each supported voltage tier
routing.notes: Do not mistake an assembler processing recipe (recipes.gtceu.assembler) for the crafting recipe of the Assembler machine

routing.applies_when: GTCEu electric motor, piston, conveyor module, robot arm, circuit; lower-tier crafting
routing.note: Many components have more than one valid recipe; present choices without inventing a preferred option

routing.search_strategy: Exact output item ID first; use one broad fallback for ambiguous code paths; GitHub code search targets main and results must be re-checked at pinned commit.

stopping_rules.first_answer: As soon as direct recipe and immediate materials are source-grounded, supply a partial answer; do not wait for unrelated recursive branches to finish
stopping_rules.deep_dependency_expansion: only on request or when needed to resolve an immediate blocker; label unresolved otherwise
stopping_rules.ci_check: one run after the grouped changes, unless failures justify fixes
